name: jls2-complete-product-development-gates
notes: This gate measures the complete JLS2 file API, including file I/O, hashing, framing, selector work, atomic publication, and exact decode.
Rates are development evidence only and are valid only after the quiet-host preflight passes.
The accepted development payload must remain byte-identical; a representation change requires a new frozen protocol.
Blind validation remains sealed until this gate and the independent competitor-baseline gate pass.
